title: FairShare
tagline: Fairyshare leverages Worldcoin ID to prevent repeat claims/sybill attacks and ensure fair distribution of resources(donations/funds/grants/incentives etc.), all built on Scroll's EVM Equivalent zk rollup for efficiency.
description: We ensure fair distribution by verifying individuals' uniqueness using WorldID at a biometric level. This guarantees that each person can only receive the distribution once. Distributors can announce a general code locally, and the first 100 people with a WorldID who enter the code "XXX" will receive $10. Once claimed, the same person cannot claim again, ensuring efficiency and fairness.
how_its_made:
Our project combines the power of biometric verification through Worldcoin ID and the efficiency of Scroll's EVM Equivalent zk rollup to ensure fair and secure distribution of resources.

Technologies Used
Worldcoin ID:

Purpose: Verifies the uniqueness of users through biometric authentication.
Integration: Users sign in using Worldcoin ID, ensuring they can only participate once.
Scroll (EVM Equivalent zk rollup):

Purpose: Provides a scalable and efficient blockchain environment for transactions.
Integration: Handles smart contracts for campaign creation, donations, and resource distribution.
